title: 第17章 你不会是想举报我吧第18章 灵宝商会
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 高麻子与邪修祭献血肉生出的邪物交手两招后，就知道不是对手，连忙后撤。
转头想向那不知来路的炼气五层修士求助，看对方的样子，确实不太像是邪修。
然而当他回过头来时，郑常早就不见了踪影。
“嗯？跑了？”
高麻子面露疑惑，本来还觉得郑常没有问题的他一下子生出了疑惑。
这个叫郑常的，到底是什么来头？
此时被人怀疑身份的郑常已经用御风术跑得远远的了。
“敖青啊，咱们就这么跑了，那些人没事是吧？”
郑常还是有些不放心，衙差好歹算个执法者，逃避执法者检查，还是让郑常有些不安心。
“你给人家操什么心啊，那三邪修献祭了自己，成了血肉魔，那些小喽啰怕是一个都跑不了了。”
“这么危险的吗？”郑常回忆起刚刚那团血肉融化的和史莱姆一样的恶心东西，没觉着有太大危险啊。
“在那的都是炼气三层以下的修士，没掌握多少术法，没法对血肉魔造成有效伤害。在这悬空山里，连逃跑都要用御风术。这些人怕是逃都逃不掉，全都要被那血肉魔吞噬了。”
“等那些人被血肉魔吞噬了，血肉魔的实力大涨，可就危险了，君子不立危墙之下。还是赶紧跑吧。”
“要不要向人报告一下这里的情况？”
“没想到郑常你这么没常识，却挺遵纪守法的啊？”
郑常脸色一黑：“什么叫我没常识？”
虽然这是事实吧，但你也不能直接说出来吧。
【宿主，你好像有击败邪修的支线任务，你要试试吗？】
本来郑常有些犹豫的，这会儿被系统提醒了一下反应过来了。
自己是来观光的，不是来修仙的。碰见危险应该躲远点，怎么还往上凑呢？
这种心态要不得！
这样想着，郑常的御风术再度增强，远离危险的速度又快上了几分。
“好了，这悬空山不安全了，咱们还是去别的地方吧。”
“接下来你打算去哪？”敖青忍不住问道。
“先去找人报告一下这里的情况吧，那个麻匪……那个高麻子不是说他是晏城的三等衙差吗？我们先去晏城吧。”
原本郑常想去的就近的田庄享受一下田园风光的。
不过临时改道也不影响，反正自己也是观光，上哪观光不是观光啊。
“你要进城？不好吧，我怕我被发现……”敖青有些担忧道。
“等会，敖青，你不会是什么通缉犯吧？？”
郑常这才意识到，因为跳过剧情的缘故，自己对这位藏在瀑布底下溶洞里，只剩下一个脑袋的同伴好像有那么亿点点不太了解。
“那…那怎么可能，我风龙族也是有头有脸的，那能让族人上通缉令啊？”
“所以你也不知道风龙族有没有通缉你咯？”郑常看出了敖青的慌乱，猜到敖青情况。
“……也不用太紧张，我现在身躯已经重塑成蛇身了，气息和之前不一样了，只要没有神魂检测，应该大概也许不会被认出来的。”
无语了，自己怎么开局就和通缉犯厮混在一起了？轻松的观光旅游不会变成逃亡生活吧？
要不举报敖青算了……
content_en:
After Gao Mazi exchanged two blows with the evil creature produced by the evil cultivator's sacrifice of flesh and blood, he knew that he was no match for him and quickly retreated.
He turned around and wanted to ask for help from the fifth-level Qi Refining monk whose origin he didn't know. Judging from his appearance, he really didn't look like an evil cultivator.
However, when he turned around, Zheng Chang had long disappeared.
"Huh? Ran away?"
Gao Mazi looked confused. He originally thought there was nothing wrong with Zheng Chang, but he suddenly became confused.
What is the origin of this person named Zheng Chang?
At this time, Zheng Chang, whose identity was suspected, had already used the wind control technique to run far away.
"Ao Qing, let's just run away. Are those people okay?"
Zheng Chang was still a little uneasy. After all, the cadre was a law enforcer, and evading inspection by law enforcers still made Zheng Chang a little uneasy.
"Why are you worrying about others? Those three evil cultivators sacrificed themselves and became flesh demons. I'm afraid none of those little minions can escape."
"Is it so dangerous?" Zheng Chang recalled the disgusting thing like slime that melted flesh and blood just now, and didn't think it was too dangerous.
"The monks there are all monks below the third level of Qi Refining. They don't have many spells and can't cause effective damage to the flesh demon. In this hanging mountain, you have to use wind control to even escape. I'm afraid these people won't be able to escape, and they will all be swallowed by the flesh demon."
"When those people are devoured by the flesh demon, the strength of the flesh demon will increase greatly, but it will be dangerous. A gentleman does not stand under a dangerous wall. It is better to run away quickly."
"Do you want to report the situation here?"
"I didn't expect you, Zheng Chang, to be so devoid of common sense, yet so law-abiding?"
Zheng Chang's face darkened: "What do you mean I don't have common sense?"
Although this is true, you can't say it directly.
[Host, you seem to have a side mission to defeat the evil cultivator. Do you want to try it? 】
Zheng Chang was hesitant at first, but now he reacted after being reminded by the system.
I came here for sightseeing, not to cultivate immortality. If you encounter danger, you should stay away. Why are you moving forward?
This mentality is unacceptable!
Thinking like this, Zheng Chang's wind control skills strengthened again, and he could move away from danger a little faster.
"Okay, this Hanging Mountain is no longer safe, let's go somewhere else."
"Where do you plan to go next?" Ao Qing couldn't help but ask.
"Let's go find someone to report the situation here first. That Mock Bandit... didn't that Gao Mazi say that he is the third-class cadre of Yancheng? Let's go to Yancheng first."
Zheng Chang originally wanted to go to a nearby farm to enjoy the pastoral scenery.
However, the temporary rerouting does not affect it. After all, I am also sightseeing, and going sightseeing is not sightseeing.
"You want to go into the city? Oh no, I'm afraid I'll be discovered..." Ao Qing said worriedly.
"Wait a minute, Ao Qing, you are not a wanted criminal, are you??"
Only then did Zheng Chang realize that because he skipped the plot, he didn't seem to know a lot about this companion who was hiding in the cave under the waterfall with only one head left.
"Then... how is that possible? We, the Wind Dragon Clan, are also well-known. How can we make our people put on a wanted order?"
"So you don't know if the Wind Dragon Clan wants you?" Zheng Chang saw Ao Qing's panic and guessed Ao Qing's situation.
"...Don't be too nervous. My body has been reshaped into a snake body now, and my aura is different from before. As long as there is no soul detection, I probably won't be recognized."
I'm speechless. Why did I start hanging out with wanted criminals? Wouldn't a relaxing sightseeing trip turn into a life of escape?
How about reporting Ao Qing...
